about_the_game:
The Archaic: UNAUTHORIZED is a story-driven 3D action platformer that blends metroidvania exploration with fluid traversal and tactical melee combat.

Play as a 17-year-old girl from 2025, suddenly summoned into a future where no organic humans remain.

Explore a broken civilization governed by digital memory and false immortality, and reignite the forgotten oath of return.

- Traverse mysterious ruins and massive sky structures

- Unlock new abilities through a central hub in orbit: Agitory

- Fight rogue androids, corrupted systems, and remnants of humanity

- Explore a world full of secrets, memories, and danger

A 4-hour demo will be available during Next Fest. Try it and see how far her will can go.


🎮 Gameplay Information (Structured – English for Steam Page with Video Attachments)

This game combines three core genres into a hybrid gameplay experience:

1. 3D Platforming X Metroidvania

The game follows classic 3D platforming rules — you’ll run, jump, wall-kick, slide, and perform light parkour.
You’ll interact with various environmental objects like springs, traps, and safety nets to traverse levels.

However, certain paths are initially unreachable.
This is where the metroidvania-style progression comes in: unlocking special abilities allows you to access previously unreachable areas.

There are 9 unique abilities, including:

2. TPS Shooting Mechanics

The game includes TPS (Third-Person Shooter) elements.
Players can aim precisely while moving quickly, allowing for fluid, responsive gunplay.

You can collect and combine Gun Modules, enabling you to construct different types of firearms.
These can fire specialized rounds with unique properties.

However, guns alone won’t kill most enemies — they can knock them back or stun them at best.

3. Momentum-Based Sword Combat

Swords are the most powerful weapons in this world.
Unlike guns, swords are the only way to defeat most enemies.

Combat revolves around:

  • Direct 1v1 confrontations

Parrying and dodging

  • Or, using momentum and aerial control to land decisive finishing blows

Mastering movement and momentum is key to success.

Core Identity

This game’s core identity is the seamless blend of:

  • Ability-driven metroidvania progression

  • Momentum-based combat

  • Platforming traversal

The game includes a variety of collectible elements

  • Various hairstyles and helmets

  • Outfits with functional bonuses depending on what you wear

  • Gun modules

A wide selection of swords with different characteristics

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: i7 9700 or Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: A story-driven 3D action platformer set in a post-immortal future, where the last organic human awakens. Explore levels with metroidvania progression, momentum-based traversal, and tactical combat. Uncover the ruins of a world that chose immortality over humanity.
